instruction: How many songs from across my spotify song and album libraries were released in this or last year?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only knowledge gathering. The single song object `library-song` abstracts the iteration over every song returned by show_song_library (paginated); show_song is modeled once and its nullary effect `library-song-release-dates-known` stands for having fetched release dates of all library songs. Album library entries already carry release_date and song_ids, so no per-album lookup is needed. phone.get_current_date_and_time grounds the 'this or last year' threshold (start of 2022). Username comes from supervisor.show_profile (static `supervisor-username` fact) and the spotify password from show_account_passwords. The answer count is passed to supervisor.complete_task, whose precondition equals all goal facts except task-completed.
